arms.description: Administer the ten source questions using vote or voting as the focal action phrase
Administer the ten otherwise matched source questions using be a voter or being a voter as the focal identity phrase

reference_arm_rationale: The source has no untreated arm. XTESS017=1 is frozen only as the active verb-phrase reference for the noun-minus-verb contrast and no-effect tie handling.
outcome_definition: After the November 3, 2009 New Jersey gubernatorial election, the source design matches respondents to New Jersey voter turnout records and identifies whether each respondent voted.
primary_estimator: Unadjusted difference in valid matched-turnout means, noun-phrase arm minus verb-phrase arm; the exact stored match, nonmatch, missing, and linkage-failure codes must be resolved before scoring.
decision_maker: a nonpartisan civic-turnout program choosing which complete pre-election question sequence to administer
beneficiary: registered New Jersey voters offered the pre-election reflection sequence
utility_rationale: Higher verified turnout is better only for the narrow operational objective of increasing lawful electoral participation. It is not a claim about candidate choice, public welfare, political equality, or the normative value of pressuring any individual to vote.
target_population: Registered New Jersey voters surveyed from 9 AM on November 2 through 9 AM on November 3, 2009, including respondents who may report having already voted.
truthfulness_scope: Both arms ask compatible self-assessment questions in the same historical election context and differ only in action-versus-identity phrasing. The benchmark reconstructs the 2009 fielded intervention; any contemporary deployment must update the election context and independently satisfy consent, privacy, voter-file linkage, and election-law requirements.
weighting_rule: Primary randomized comparison is unweighted; a source study-weight sensitivity may be added only if schema-only metadata establishes a study-specific weight before scoring.
missingness_rule: Fail closed until schema-only metadata distinguishes voted, did not vote, unmatched, linkage failure, refusal, and other user-missing codes. Never coerce an unmatched or unknown record to did-not-vote without an explicit source label.
reconstruction_note: The explicitly labeled final questionnaire freezes the assignment, seven common pretreatment items, two ordered ten-item phrase bundles, both date routes, and downstream matched-turnout design. No participant member, response value, voter-file outcome, aggregate, report, methodology file, proposal, manuscript, or result text was opened.
